objective: Canario 6/6: comprobar unicamente poblacion PersonaID de dbo.CavaSocios_Socios.

queries.name: personaid_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS personaid_null,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS personaid_present FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios
